basis: Valid values 1..5: sum=15, sum squared deviations=10, sample variance=10/4; std=sqrt(5/2). Symmetry gives skew=0. Sum fourth deviations=34 yields uncorrected Pearson=1.7 and sample-corrected excess=-6/5. Quartiles and tails use linear interpolation; MAD=1. Null is omitted and counted.
tolerance_reason: Small deterministic samples; tolerance covers float64 rounding only. Integer counts and labels are exact.
